name: Mufti Dr. Mohamed Maqsood Imran Rashadi

photo.alt: Mufti Dr. Mohamed Maqsood Imran Rashadi in a white turban and a grey waistcoat, speaking at a microphone
photo.note: The exact file supplied by the website owner (650 x 399 px, 17.7 KB, byte-identical). Shown whole, never cropped.

designations.title: Chief Imam & Khateeb
designations.text: Leads the congregation and delivers the Friday Khutbah and religious guidance.
designations.check: Deccan Herald calls him "the chief imam of Jamia Masjid" in Bengaluru. City Market is the location the Trust's own pages give for Jamia Masjid.

designations.title: Principal
designations.text: Provides educational leadership and oversees academic, religious and character development.
designations.check: No public source found. The earlier Governing Body poster on this site names a different person as "Principal in chief"; confirm the title and its dates with the Trust.

designations.title: Member, Imarat-e-Shariah, Karnataka
designations.text: Contributes to the religious, educational and community responsibilities of Imarat-e-Shariah, Karnataka.
designations.check: Imarat-e-Shariah Karnataka announced a three-member committee after the death of its Ameer-e-Shariat in January 2026, but the pages that could be read do not name its members.

designations.title: Convener, Karnataka Moon Sighting Committee
designations.text: Coordinates moon-sighting activities and communicates decisions concerning the commencement of Islamic months, including Ramadan, Shawwal and Dhul-Hijjah.
designations.check: Deccan Herald (Ramzan 2024) calls him "convenor" of the committee; ETV Bharat (Feb 2025) calls him "member of the State Moon Sighting Committee". Confirm the present title.

designations.title: Islamic Scholar, Educator & Community Leader
designations.text: Engages in Islamic scholarship, teaching, public lectures, community guidance and youth mentorship.
designations.check: A general description. Public sources found do not state the academic titles "Mufti" or "Dr."; confirm them.

designations.title: Ameer-e-Shariyat, Karnataka (Member)
designations.text: Serves as a member of the Ameer-e-Shariyat leadership structure, contributing to religious guidance and community responsibilities in Karnataka.
designations.check: No public source found that names him in this structure. Islamic Voice (Jan 2026) refers to the late Maulana Sagheer Ahmed Rashadi as Karnataka's Ameer-e-Shariat.

_notes: biography and languages are printed only when an entry has "verified": true. None has been supplied or verified, so none is shown.
